content.title: Where to Watch Orlando Magic Games | TV & Radio Broadcast
content.text: Local TV & Streaming Watch the Orlando Magic All Season Long! FanDuel Sports Network is your home for Orlando Magic games—stream every matchup not nationally televised, plus enjoy live pregame and postgame coverage. Ways to Watch on FanDuel Sports Network: Streaming Subscription: Get a FanDuel Sports Network season pass and save up to 25% Off. Shop Plans Prime Video: Add FanDuel Sports Network to your Prime Video subscription. Visit Amazon.com/channels and search for FanDuel Sports Network to subscribe. Cable/Satellite: FanDuel Sports Network is Available on Spectrum, DIRECTV, Xfinity, Fubo, and more. View All Local Listings Local TV Games The Orlando Magic, WESH 2, CW18, WMOR-TV, and FanDuel Sports Network Florida have partnered to simulcast 10 Magic games during the 2025-26 season on Hearst stations in Central Florida and Tampa. Fans can also watch on FanDuel Sports Network Florida, the FanDuel app, and FanDuelSportsNetwork.com. Magic Radio Network Listen to Orlando Magic Games on the Go! All preseason, regular season, and postseason Magic games are aired on the Magic Radio Network, with affiliates across Florida. In Orlando, FM 96.9 The Game serves as the flagship station, also available on AM 740 and via the iHeart Radio App*. *Select games may air on FM 104.5 instead of FM 96.9 and AM 740. FAQs
